info.title: Aurora Gateway API
info.description:
Aurora Voice Assistant HTTP Gateway API.

This API provides HTTP access to Aurora services via the message bus.
Routes are dynamically generated from the contract registry.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints accept **either** of the following:

| Method | Header | Example |
|--------|--------|---------|
| API Key | `X-API-Key: <key>` | `X-API-Key: my-secret-key` |
| Bearer Token | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` | `Authorization: Bearer eyJ…` |

Use the **Authorize** button above to set credentials for "Try it out".

Canonical public auth routes are `POST /api/Auth/Login`, `POST /api/Auth/PairingStart`, `POST /api/Auth/PairingConnect`, and `POST /api/Auth/PairingExchange`. When auth is enabled, these routes run as an anonymous caller, not as the system principal.
